keyPhrases.text: A much better show than I anticipated!
Our three ladies are solid in voice and character development
Faith Prince has great comic timing
Christine Sherrill, is as always, divine
I think they could make a few cuts here and there
may not be needed at all

reasoning: Mixed-positive review with genuine enthusiasm but notable reservations about length and pacing. Strong praise for performances balanced by constructive criticism about cuts needed. Falls in 3/5 range despite positive overall impression.
